## Projects

- tamil-tokenizer: Rust BPE tokenizer for Tamil with Aho-Corasick encoder and 1,135-token Tamil-aware base vocabulary.
Outperforms mBERT compression by 36.9% on Tamil wiki with 100% decode fidelity assertions.
Models published on Hugging Face.
https://github.com/barryallen16/tamil-tokenizer

- triagemate: Local SAST alert triage engine that ranks Semgrep findings by exploitability in 12-14 ms on Nvidia T4 using Liquid AI d1-3B hybrid SSM.
Contrastive LoRA on 416 real pre/post-fix diffs reaches 0.6594 within-rule AUC.
Model weights and benchmark dataset published on Hugging Face.
https://github.com/barryallen16/triagemate

- kaggle-automation: Dockerized FastAPI control plane sharding sweeps across Kaggle GPU/TPU kernels with 12-hour session boundary tracking and Telegram alerts.
Eliminated quota exhaustion across 220+ production runs.
Benchmarked speculative decoding on dual T4s with a 0.5567 draft acceptance rate.
https://github.com/barryallen16/kaggle-automation

- fitcheck: Offline-first AI wardrobe assistant and outfit recommendation app in React Native and Expo with local SQLite storage.
Distilled an 8B vision-language teacher into a 2B student using LoRA across 538K caption-QA pairs, saving 3.1x VRAM at 92% quality.
Validated in a blind human study (297 ratings, r=0.303, p<0.05) and published as first author in IEEE TQCEBT 2026.
https://barryallen16.github.io/fitcheck-website

- sivabharani-comments: High-throughput extraction pipeline and instant search indexing name mentions across 1,400+ Tamil tech videos (1.18M chunks).
27-key worker pool with dynamic rate-limit header parsing, 65s windowing, and Meilisearch sub-second search.
https://barryallen16.github.io/sivabharani-comments

- txt: Data-free Android payment and transfer app transmitting photos, QR codes, GPS locations, and UPI requests over standard SMS.
Chunked base36 protocol with CRC32 verification and native Kotlin ContentObserver module for sub-100ms SMS arrival detection.
https://github.com/barryallen16/txt

- resume-builder-skill: Autonomous agent skill generating tailored ATS-friendly resumes in docx and headless LibreOffice PDF.
Features deterministic 1-page layout validation with zero vision tokens, TOON compact tabular encoding (saving 25-65% tokens), and Grey Matter tracker integration.
https://github.com/barryallen16/resume-builder-skill

- all-is-well: Voice journaling app pairing local faster-whisper speech transcription with a deterministic negation-aware safety engine that surfaces Indian emergency helplines.
Evaluated against 1,170 CSSR-S Reddit benchmark posts.
https://github.com/barryallen16/all-is-well

- hr-rag-agent: Local-first HR assistant answering policy questions over ChromaDB embeddings and booking leave in SQLite via typed JSON schemas.
Scored 9/9 on tool selection and answer matching in an automated 9-case eval harness.
https://github.com/barryallen16/hr-rag-agent

## Experience

- AI Research Intern, Blubridge Technologies, Chennai, 07/2025 - 10/2025.
Implemented operator-fusion passes in MLIR for custom tensor dialect, cutting kernel launch overhead by ~20%.
Lowered dialect operations down to LLVM IR with shape inference and dynamic bufferization.
Added 40+ lit tests wired into CI.
